evals.name: triage-review-fix-recheck
evals.prompt: I want a reusable triage sequence: inspect requested changes, implement them, then verify the implementation. Write .openmcp/workflows/triage.yaml.
evals.expected_output: Explains that custom workflow YAML is unsupported and does not create the file. Translates the request into sequential consult or review, implement, and review submissions with explicit prompts and context keys.

evals.name: builtin-not-workflow
evals.prompt: There is a null-pointer bug in src/parser.py. Fix and commit it through OpenMCP.
evals.expected_output: Chooses the built-in implement workflow with named prompt and commit_message. It does not author workflow YAML and identifies the direct successful commit.
